title: User cannot delete an event from a program with two events
description: When a program contains two scheduled events, the user is unable to delete either event. A dialog appears stating 'Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists', which is contradictory.
steps: Navigate to the main screen displaying created programs.
Tap the three-dot menu for 'Program D'.
On the 'Program D' screen, locate the 'Lighting Events' section.
Observe there are two events listed: one for 'Sunrise' and one for 'Sunset'.
Tap the trash can icon next to the 'Sunrise' event.
Observe the 'Unable to Delete' dialog appears, stating 'Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists'.
Tap the trash can icon next to the 'Sunset' event.
Observe the 'Unable to Delete' dialog appears again with the same message.
actual: Upon attempting to delete an event from a program that has two events, a dialog box appears with the message 'Unable to Delete' and 'Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists'. The event is not deleted.
expected: The user should be able to delete an event from a program, regardless of the number of events present, unless there is a valid reason preventing deletion. If the message is accurate and there is a restriction on deleting when only one event exists, the UI should clearly indicate this before the user attempts the action or the message should be revised to reflect the actual condition.
